blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A 34-year-old man with a speech impediment was wounded after he was shot over a personal dispute in Dasmariñas City, Cavite, on Tuesday, police reported. The victim was walking home from work when the suspect, a 55-year-old neighbor, approached him and allegedly fired a .38-caliber revolver, hitting him in the right shoulder, according to a report on Wednesday by the Calabarzon police. The suspect fled after the shooting but was later arrested, police said.
